title: rlds-paired: Paired Dark-Sector Signature SDK
description: Reference implementation for the Regime-Limited Dynamical Systems (RLDS) interacting dark-sector model, accompanying RLDS Papers III-VI. Version 1.1.0 adds the corrected and DESI DR2-validated likelihood (Planck 2018 distance priors with early-time matter density, DESI DR2 BAO and Pantheon+ with full covariances), profile-likelihood and scan tools, and all scripts, outputs and chains needed to reproduce RLDS VI, the closing analysis against DESI DR2 (see REPRODUCE_VI.md). The legacy likelihood of Papers III-IV is kept unchanged for reproducibility.
